note: Playwright engines on one Linux build host (emeth4), two pages in one context, offer and answer exchanged by the script (the manual/QR path), iceServers empty. Chromium and Firefox established the ordered reliable om-lan-v1 channel and received 256 frames of 16 KiB in order with host-only mDNS candidates and no srflx or relay. WebKit exposes RTCPeerConnection but gathered only .local (mDNS) host candidates and did not establish (cause not isolated: no mDNS resolution in this environment). This is NOT evidence about iOS Safari, real phones, other Wi-Fi networks, client isolation or the iOS local-network permission; those need real devices (operator item). Per ADR-0158 section 4 a runtime that cannot establish the channel reports local_delivery = unavailable.

verdicts.webkit: not established in this environment: report unavailable until a real-device run shows otherwise
